channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: A peek inside the Fed's renovations that are now at the center of a DOJ probe
item.description: The Federal Reserve is three years into renovating its historic buildings. President Donald Trump has criticized the project's cost overruns.

item.title: Eric Clapton 2026 tour: Full schedule, venues, and where to buy tickets
item.description: See all Eric Clapton 2026 tour dates across Europe. Find out where to buy tickets, how much they cost, and what to expect from the guitar legend's live shows.

item.title: Living abroad for 28 years gave me everything I wanted — and a quiet guilt I still carry
item.description: When Kris LeBoutillier's mom got older and her health declined, she wanted him closer to home. "Haven't you been in Singapore long enough?," she asked him.

item.title: Trump says that Microsoft will 'ensure' Americans don't 'pick up the tab' for its data center power consumption
item.description: President Donald Trump said that tech companies must pay for their own data centers without spiking utility bills for American households.

item.title: The controversy behind Jerome Powell's Senate testimony, from the VIP dining room to the special elevators
item.description: Jerome Powell says the criminal investigation centers on a June Senate hearing, where he got into a heated exchange over the Fed's renovation plans.

item.title: Here's what smart people in economics and business are saying about the DOJ's Fed probe
item.description: Powell described the move as a part of a broader effort to pressure the central bank on monetary policy.

item.title: A new Ukrainian way of intercepting drones midair looks like a fishing rod in the sky
item.description: The 46th Separate Air Mobile Brigade showcased a "new way of capture" for enemy drones that seems to use a line or cord to fight quadcopters.

item.title: Oprah Winfrey, 71, says she regrets not using GLP-1s sooner because of the 'wasted sadness and shame'
item.description: "I have become indifferent to food. I still love it. I still love it. But I'm not in any way obsessed about it," Oprah Winfrey said.

item.title: A viral app that helps people check if their friends are alive sparks discussions about loneliness in China
item.description: An app asking "Are you dead?" has gone viral in China, sparking debate about loneliness and the risks of living alone.

item.title: Klarna CEO backs Trump's 10% credit card cap, criticizing rewards as built on poorer borrowers' debt
item.description: Even people who don't use credit cards pay more for everyday goods because merchants raise prices to cover card fees, said Klarna's CEO.
